investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Brighteron Freight (freight and logistics); Platform: AWS ca-central-1 (zones ca-central-1a/ca-central-1b/ca-central-1d); network range 10.136.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster bright-prod-cacent (EKS); Object storage: provider-managed bucket/account for user content, accessed directly by backend services; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
